# Euclid

> A native macOS launcher for developers. Every action is a shell command in ~/.config/euclid/config.toml; plugins are folders with a plugin.toml and a script that prints JSON lines.

- [Plugin guide for agents](https://lgtm.ninja/euclid/plugins/AGENTS.md): the full plugin format, with rules and examples
- [Plugins and actions](https://lgtm.ninja/euclid/plugins/): directory of plugins and copy-paste actions
- [Docs: every feature, config key and command-line option](https://lgtm.ninja/euclid/docs/)
- [Changelog](https://lgtm.ninja/euclid/changelog/): what changed in each release, plus the latest dev build
